items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Well, at this point now you'd moved out of Mrs. Carney's friend's...

ctx.x: I didn't pay attention to the vocalist. Oh, Louis Armstrong was the vocalist. And he had a little megaphone -- because there was no microphones in them days. He had a little megaphone, singing through it, scattin'. He was scattin', because he didn't know the words. But he was sensational...
Did you go to that thing...? Was Carney there? Was Howard Johnson there? Johnny Hodges? Everybody went?
Well, I don't know if anyone of them particularly were there. But all the... You know, musicians and everybody else went. Yeah, I guess...
